Rs. 10 Crores second tranche investment via 1000 NOCPS of Rs. 1,00,000 each

Purpose of acquisition is to fund GSSBBL's growth, expansion plans and working capital requirements
GSSBBL is in expansion phase and needs additional funds to grow its business
Promoter/promoter group/group companies have interest in GSSBBL to the extent of their 66.01% equity shareholding in Shoppers Stop Limited
